name: Views Show More Pager
description: Provide a show more pager plugin for Views.
project_description:
Views Show More is a very unique pager plugins for view. It support different item count in 1st page and others pages. Like, you have set 6 items per page. But want to set 12 items initially in 1st page. This module cans it.

 Features 
 
 Works both views ajax and no-ajax mode (developed mainly for the ajax mode). 
 Option for result display method. Can choose Append or Replace method. 
 Option to override 1st page or initial item count than others page. 
 Basic and advance animation system for result impression for ajax mode. 
 Ability to define custom animation timing. 
 Advance settings for content area and pager area selector. If default html

 markup override using the theme tpls. 
 
 Features in 7.x-2.x version 
 
 Ability to use offset in pager. 
 
 7.x-1.x to 7.x-2.x migration 
 In 7.x-1.x version offset field used as initial items (label changed). Now, in 7.x-2.x version this field separated into 2 fields named initial items and offset. If you migrate 1.x to 2.x then you need to set offset field value to initial items and offset field to 0. Details in picture. 

 Requirements 
 
 Views 
 Ctools 
 
 Installation & Configuration 
 See the README file of this module.

 Difference from others 
 
 Difference form Views Infinite Scroll 
 
 Not worked with ajax mode. 
 Have not any option to use override per page item count. 
 Have not any option to use animation for result display. 
 This module only for auto paging. 
 
 
 Difference form Views Load More 
 
 Have not any option for result display method. 
 Have not any option to use override per page item count. 
 Have not any option to use advanced animation for result display. 
 Like Scroll to new result, Custom animation speed etc.
